title: D20 Tests
summary: For an uncertain action, roll a d20, add the relevant modifiers, and compare the total with the target number.

title: Ability Checks
summary: An ability check resolves an uncertain attempt other than an attack; use the most relevant ability modifier and add proficiency when it applies.

title: Saving Throws
summary: A saving throw resists a threat. Its target comes from the effect or the GM, and proficiency applies only when the creature has that save proficiency.

title: Attack Rolls
summary: An attack hits when its total meets the target Armor Class. A natural 20 hits and is a critical hit; a natural 1 misses.

title: Advantage and Disadvantage
summary: For advantage or disadvantage, roll two d20s and use the higher or lower result respectively before applying modifiers.

title: Armor Class
summary: A creature has one base Armor Class calculation at a time. The default base calculation uses 10 plus Dexterity modifier before other applicable modifiers.

title: Proficiency
summary: Proficiency adds a character’s current bonus to an applicable d20 test. Character proficiency increases with level.
